title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Cleaning the Kitchen 😂 ADHD Cleaning Be Like #shorts
desc:
ADHD cleaning: one counter turns into seven jobs.

Started with one plate. Ended up cleaning the junk drawer at midnight. 😂 What job ALWAYS turns into five? 👇

Tip: pick one zone, set a timer, and leave the side quests on a sticky note.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdcleaning #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny
tags: what it's like to have adhd

beats.say: Here's how a normal person cleans the kitchen. Do the dishes. Wipe the counter. Done.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. One plate. I'm just gonna put this one plate in the dishwasher.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: The dishwasher is full. Of clean dishes. From Tuesday.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Full. Of clean dishes. From Tuesday.

beats.say: Okay, put those away. Wait, why is this cabinet such a mess?
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Why is this cabinet a mess?

beats.say: Pulled everything out. Found a cup I lost in March. Found the good tape.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: This tape is perfect for labeling. Every jar in this kitchen is getting a label.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: And while I'm here, the junk drawer.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: The jars have labels. The junk drawer is perfect. And the plate is still in my hand.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: The plate. Still in my hand.

beats.say: Here's why. An ADHD brain sees every job hiding behind the first one, and it chases all of them. Pick one zone, set a timer, and put the side quests on a sticky note for later.
beats.cap2: Tip: one zone. Side quests on a sticky note.

beats.say: What chore always turns into five for you? Tell me in the comments.
